assistant|recommended_book: Gone Girl by Gillian Flynn — psychological thriller about a marriage that turns dark (narrated by Julia Whelan and Kirby Heyborne)
The Silent Patient by Alex Michaelides — psychological thriller about a painter who shoots her husband and stops speaking (narrated by Louise Brealey and Kobna Holdbrook-Smith)
The 7 1/2 Deaths of Evelyn Hardcastle by Stuart Turton — mind-bending murder mystery at a country manor (narrated by James Cameron Stewart)
The Three-Body Problem by Liu Cixin — sci-fi epic about first contact with an alien civilization (narrated by Luke Daniels)
The First Fifteen Lives of Harry August by Claire North — novel about a man reborn every time he dies (narrated by Peter Kenny)
The Lies of Locke Lamora by Scott Lynch — fantasy adventure about con artists (narrated by Simon Vance)
The Nightingale by Kristin Hannah — WWII historical fiction in France following sisters Vianne and Isabelle Rossignol (narrated by Polly Stone)
The Power by Naomi Alderman — speculative fiction where women can release electrical jolts from their fingertips (narrated by Adjoa Andoh)
The Song of Achilles by Madeline Miller — reimagines the Trojan War from Patroclus's perspective (narrated by Frazer Douglas)
The Hate U Give by Angie Thomas — YA novel about a black teenager who witnesses a friend's fatal police shooting (narrated by Bahni Turpin)
Eleanor Oliphant is Completely Fine by Gail Honeyman — about a socially awkward woman finding love and friendship (narrated by Joanne Froggatt)
The Rosie Project by Graeme Simsion — humorous novel about a professor seeking a partner scientifically (narrated by Dan O'Grady)
assistant|book_detail: The Nightingale was published in 2015, became a New York Times bestseller, and its audiobook runtime is approximately 17 hours 30 minutes
assistant|note_taking_app_recommendation: Notion — versatile, customizable note app; supports tags, timestamp links; exports to CSV/JSON/Markdown; shares to Twitter, Slack, Trello
Simplenote — minimalistic note app with syncing, tags, Markdown, and search; exports as plain text, Markdown, or HTML
Bear — note app with tags, audio/image attachments, focus mode; exports as text/Markdown/HTML and shares quotes to Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn
Evernote — note app with audio notes, tagging, web clipper; exports as HTML/PDF/plain text and shares to Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn
Otter — app designed for note-taking while listening to audiobooks/podcasts; generates summaries and exports quotes as images; shares to Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn
Audiobooks.com's Notes — built-in note-taking feature in the Audiobooks.com app for notes, bookmarks, and ratings
assistant|nightingale_plot_details: In The Nightingale, both sisters join the French Resistance: Vianne helps downed airmen escape, while Isabelle takes on dangerous rebel missions
assistant|nightingale_themes: The Nightingale explores themes of sisterhood, bravery, survival, and love, highlighting the often-overlooked courage of women during wartime
assistant|audiobook_note_app_features: Features to look for in audiobook note-taking apps: timestamps, tagging and organization, search function, cloud syncing, and customization
assistant|audiobook_retention_reasons: Audiobooks may improve retention and recall due to dual coding, emotional connection from narrators, natural pacing and rhythm, and multitasking
assistant|note_taking_benefits: Taking notes while listening helps process information more deeply, identify key takeaways, and review/reflect to solidify understanding
